grid.swell: weatherFixtures: max(0.2, 0.35×Hs) from the wave direction

fieldsUsed.printed: utils/beachConditionsReadout.buildBeachConditionsReadout(...).waveM, i.e. printedWaveHeightM(min(score.shoreDisplayWaveM, score.waveHeightM)), shown to one decimal — the card path (components/BeachCard.tsx); pages/BeachDetailPage.tsx shoreWaveHeightM applies the same min()
fieldsUsed.pinTone: resolveConditionTone with components/BeachMap.tsx beachToneInput arguments over App.tsx mapSuitableBeaches-shaped items (which carry NO shoreShadowDamping)
fieldsUsed.pinToneWired: same, but shoreShadowDamping/forecastUncertain taken from the score (what the gate section E assumes the pin reads)
fieldsUsed.chipTone: score.simpleWindSuitability.suitabilityColor (card chip; applySeaStateToWindSuitability passes no K_d either)
fieldsUsed.podium: services/recommendationService.getSuitableBeaches over all 39 Paros beaches; top 3 = first three

changeTiersMeaning.shown: printed number, wave word, pin colour, card chip or swim verdict differs
changeTiersMeaning.pin-if-wired: only the pin colour computed WITH the score K_d differs (not what production shows)
changeTiersMeaning.score-only: only finalSuitabilityScore differs (list ranking input); nothing on screen
changeTiersMeaning.shore-number-only: only score.shoreDisplayWaveM differs; the card caps it at score.waveHeightM or the 0.10 m floor, so the printed figure is identical
changeTiersMeaning.kd-only: only score.shoreShadowDamping differs; the sea is not a sheltered arrival there, so no reader consumes K_d

wiringFinding.summary: In production neither the map pin nor the card chip receives K_d: App.tsx mapSuitableBeaches items do not copy score.shoreShadowDamping (BeachMap.tsx forwards item.shoreShadowDamping = undefined), and recommendationService passes no K_d to applySeaStateToWindSuitability. Both therefore use the historical 0.5 for protected/enclosed shores. Gate section E only checks that BeachMap.tsx forwards the field, not that the item carries it.
wiringFinding.consequenceForMolos: Inside the hole the pin and chip already assumed 0.5 of the open sea while the card printed 0.1; after the arc fix the printed number agrees with them. pinTone vs pinToneWired show whether wiring would change the colour here.
